# Mac Clamshell MCP **Keep your MacBook cool, quiet, and its built-in screen truly off when running builds or AI agents with the lid closed.** [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](assets/release-badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ![macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-Apple%20Silicon%20%7C%20Intel-1A1916?logo=apple&logoColor=white) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## What it does Closed MacBooks running docked or remote builds often overheat and leave the internal backlight lit. Mac Clamshell MCP watches lid, power, and thermal state to keep your Mac quiet and cool: - **Turns off the closed built-in screen**: While Antigravity is open, the MCP server (`serve`) runs a lightweight display guard automatically—dropping backlight to 0% and sleeping the internal display on lid close, then restoring your previous brightness on wake. - **Throttles heavy builds automatically**: Adapts CPU priority and parallel job limits from lid state, AC vs. battery power, and macOS thermal pressure (Apple Silicon & Intel). - **Stays out of the way when open**: Silent in Antigravity while open and cool; only nudges the agent to wrap heavy commands and cap concurrency when throttled. - **Live bilingual panel, brightness & one-click lock**: Inspect status in Antigravity (`EN / 中文`), toggle the display guard or mode override, adjust brightness, or lock the screen without sleeping background jobs. | Mode | When it activates | What it does | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Normal** | Lid open and cool | Full speed, no throttling | | **Utility** | Lid closed on AC power | Utility CPU QoS (`nice 10`), limits jobs to E-cores (`2–4`, or half of cores on Intel) | | **Eco** | Lid closed on battery | Background QoS (`nice 15`), max 2 jobs (1 job at 20% battery or below) | | **Strict** | Serious or critical thermal pressure | Lowest priority (`taskpolicy -b`, `nice 19`), 1 job at a time | ## How Throttling Works & Privacy - **Process-scoped, zero root**: Needs no `sudo` and never touches NVRAM, SMC, kernel extensions, or global `pmset` settings. `mac-clamshell-mcp run` applies macOS `taskpolicy` QoS, POSIX `nice`, and standard build-concurrency variables only to the wrapped command tree, leaving other apps untouched with zero residue on exit. - **Reversible user-space display guard**: Uses standard macOS `DisplayServices` user-space APIs (the same layer as Control Center) so your prior brightness restores cleanly when the lid opens or thermal pressure clears. - **100% local & private**: Zero network requests and no telemetry; settings and guard state stay in your local user directory with owner-only permissions. ## Install Requires macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel). Downloads the verified release binary and installs the plugin into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp` (restart or reload Antigravity afterward): ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh # Or pin a specific release: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --version v1.2.0 ``` Antigravity already runs the display guard while open; to keep closed-lid protection running 24/7 even when Antigravity is closed, install the LaunchAgent via `mac-clamshell-mcp guard install` below. ## How to use it ### In Antigravity Open **Mac Clamshell** in the side pane, or ask your agent (e.g., *"Check my Mac's lid, battery, and thermal status"*, *"Dim the built-in display to 30%"*, or *"Run the test suite using clamshell throttling"*): | Tool | What it does | | :--- | :--- | | `clamshell_panel` | Opens the live dashboard and reports current lid, power, thermal, and mode status. | | `clamshell_set_brightness` | Sets built-in screen brightness (0–100%) immediately when open, or updates the wake-restore level while closed without lighting the screen. | | `clamshell_lock_screen` | Locks the macOS screen immediately (`SACLockScreenImmediate` with `CGSession`/`pmset` fallback) while keeping the Mac awake for background tasks. | ### From the terminal ```sh mac-clamshell-mcp status # Lid, power, thermal, brightness & active mode mac-clamshell-mcp run -- cargo test # Run a command with automatic throttling mac-clamshell-mcp run --mode eco --jobs 2 --sh "npm run build && npm test" mac-clamshell-mcp brightness get # Read or set built-in brightness (0-100%) mac-clamshell-mcp brightness set 60 mac-clamshell-mcp lock # Lock screen immediately without sleeping # Optional 24/7 LaunchAgent guard (or run ./scripts/install-launchagent.sh) / foreground daemon: mac-clamshell-mcp guard install --interval 10 mac-clamshell-mcp guard status mac-clamshell-mcp guard uninstall mac-clamshell-mcp watch --daemon --interval 10 ``` ## Build from source Requires macOS, Rust (`cargo`), and Node.js 20+: ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp.git cd mac-clamshell-mcp (cd panel && npm install) && node panel/pack.mjs && node --test panel/test/panel.test.mjs cargo test --locked && cargo build --release --locked && ./scripts/install-plugin.sh ``` ## Contributing & License Contributions are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

# Mac Clamshell MCP **让合盖干活的 MacBook 保持凉快安静，同时确保合盖后内置屏幕彻底熄灭。** [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](assets/release-badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ![macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-Apple%20Silicon%20%7C%20Intel-1A1916?logo=apple&logoColor=white) [English](README.md) | 简体中文
## 它能帮你做什么 合盖跑编译、测试或 AI Agent 时，MacBook 往往发烫且内屏背光容易偷偷常亮。Mac Clamshell MCP 会实时监测开合盖、供电和热压力，让设备保持安静凉爽： - **合盖彻底熄屏，开盖恢复亮度**：只要 Antigravity 运行，内置 MCP 服务（`serve`）就会自动运行轻量熄屏守护——合盖即把内置屏背光降到 0% 并休眠内屏，开盖自动恢复原亮度。 - **按状态自动限流降温**：结合开合盖、电池/插电状态以及 macOS 热压力（Apple Silicon 与 Intel 均支持），自动调整 CPU 优先级与并发上限。 - **开盖时完全不打扰**：开盖且温度正常时在 Antigravity 中保持静默；仅在进入限流档位后才提醒 Agent 包裹重任务并限制并发。 - **双语面板、亮度调节与一键锁屏**：在 Antigravity 侧边栏（`EN / 中文`）查看状态、切换熄屏守护或手动档位、调节亮度，或一键锁屏并保持后台任务运行。 | 档位 | 触发条件 | 实际效果 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Normal / 正常** | 开盖且温度正常 | 不限制，全速运行 | | **Utility / 控温** | 合盖 + 插电 | Utility QoS（`nice 10`），并发限制在能效核数量（`2–4`，Intel 为总核数一半） | | **Eco / 节能** | 合盖 + 电池供电 | 后台 QoS（`nice 15`），最多 2 并发（电量低于等于 20% 时降为 1） | | **Strict / 强限** | 系统达到严重/临界热压力 | 最低优先级（`taskpolicy -b`、`nice 19`），单任务串行运行 | ## 限流原理与隐私安全 - **进程级生效、零 root 侵入**：全程无需 `sudo`，绝不改动 NVRAM、SMC、内核扩展或全局 `pmset` 设置。`mac-clamshell-mcp run` 仅对被包裹的命令树应用 macOS `taskpolicy` QoS、POSIX `nice` 与标准构建并发环境变量，不影响其他应用，退出后零残留。 - **可逆的用户态熄屏守护**：通过 macOS 标准 `DisplayServices` 用户态接口（与控制中心亮度滑块同级）调节背光，开盖或热压力恢复后自动还原原有亮度。 - **100% 本地运行、零隐私上传**：无任何联网请求或统计上报；配置与守护状态仅保存在本地用户目录且仅当前用户可读写。 ## 安装 支持 macOS（Apple Silicon 与 Intel）。安装脚本会下载并校验 SHA-256，随后安装到 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp`（完成后重启或重载 Antigravity）： ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh # 或指定版本： curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --version v1.2.0 ``` Antigravity 打开期间已自带合盖守护；如需退出 Antigravity 后仍 24/7 常驻守护，可执行下方终端命令中的 `mac-clamshell-mcp guard install` 安装 LaunchAgent。 ## 怎么用 ### 在 Antigravity 里用 从侧边栏打开 **Mac Clamshell** 面板，或直接让 Agent 操作（例如：*"看看开合盖、电量和温度状态"*、*"把内置屏幕亮度调到 30%"*、*"用合盖限流模式跑测试"*）： | 工具 | 作用 | | :--- | :--- | | `clamshell_panel` | 打开实时控制面板，返回当前开合盖、供电、温度和档位信息。 | | `clamshell_set_brightness` | 调节内置屏幕亮度（0–100%）；合盖时仅更新开盖恢复亮度，不会误点亮黑屏。 | | `clamshell_lock_screen` | 立即锁屏（原生 `SACLockScreenImmediate`，自动回退 `CGSession`/`pmset`），保持 Mac 唤醒不中断后台任务。 | ### 在终端里单独用 ```sh mac-clamshell-mcp status # 查看开合盖、供电、温度、亮度与档位 mac-clamshell-mcp run -- cargo test # 按当前档位自动包裹重型命令 mac-clamshell-mcp run --mode eco --jobs 2 --sh "npm run build && npm test" mac-clamshell-mcp brightness get # 读取或设置内置屏幕亮度（0-100%） mac-clamshell-mcp brightness set 60 mac-clamshell-mcp lock # 立即锁屏且保持 Mac 唤醒 # 可选：安装/管理 24/7 LaunchAgent 守护（或运行 ./scripts/install-launchagent.sh）/ 前台守护： mac-clamshell-mcp guard install --interval 10 mac-clamshell-mcp guard status mac-clamshell-mcp guard uninstall mac-clamshell-mcp watch --daemon --interval 10 ``` ## 从源码构建 需要 macOS、Rust（`cargo`）和 Node.js 20+： ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp.git cd mac-clamshell-mcp (cd panel && npm install) && node panel/pack.mjs && node --test panel/test/panel.test.mjs cargo test --locked && cargo build --release --locked && ./scripts/install-plugin.sh ``` ## 参与贡献与许可证 欢迎提 PR 或反馈问题，详情见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)、[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) 和 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。本项目基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源。
